text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Teio... where are we going?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who's that running over there?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El! Sh-she's really going for it...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
looks like El's revved up today too!
You two are in the same
class, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, have you ever asked El why she runs?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Why she runs? Well, no, not yet...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She runs in order to prove that she's "the
world's strongest racer"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Not just in the Twinkle Series,
either. She
wants to prove her strength
by also
winning races abroad.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest...
So that's why! El is
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Tsk, tsk, tsk. El's not the only one, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Grass is incredible too! Well,
in her case,
maybe "overwhelming"
would be more
accurate.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Do you... know why Grass runs?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haaa!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The zenith!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's her goal, and what a great goal for
a racer to have. Who cares
if it's simple?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest racer and "the
zenith"...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haha! Told you those two are amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still,
"the world's strongest racer" and "the
zenith" won't mean much
when I become
the best Umamusume to ever exist.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know President Symboli Rudolf, right?
We all say she's the best
in Tracen
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become like her and be the
best Umamusume around. No
matter who I
face, I won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's because I'm "the Invincible Teio"!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Invincible... So that's your dream...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, right now,
it's just a dream. But
we're students of Tracen
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you find a trainer here,
you'll be able to
race in the Twinkle Series.
And on the
racecourse is where our dreams lie!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here came to this academy with a
dream in their heart. It's
here, and only
here, that we can make them come true!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Make your dreams... come true!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, then how about you and I get
started already? Up for some
partner
running, new girl?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Partner running... Wait, you mean now?!
Me and you?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, right now! Come on, no dragging
your feet! It's racing time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what's your reason? Why do
you run? What're you at
Tracen Academy
for?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Why? I...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(But this is no dream. No,
I'm here to make
my dreams come true!
That's why... I have
to run!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okay, we're doing this. Ready, set... GO!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... huff... puff...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh! Good job keeping up, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But... you won't outrun me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(She's fast! The pressure I felt earlier...
it's
even more intense now!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(Does... does her strength come from the
desire to realize her
dreams?)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Well... In that case!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What the?! She completely closed the
lead I had!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Teiooo! I...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I came here to be the best Umamusume in
Japan!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Oh yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, guess what? You're not beating me,
Spe!

text_block_list.name: Teio and Special Week
text_block_list.text:
AAAHHHHH!
RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy... is a place to make
dreams come true!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Of course... so that's it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well then... Do you get it now, Spe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for showing me the
best thing about Tracen
Academy, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's nothing. Hehehe!
